magic_files.description: List of magic files or directories to use (colon-separated in actual usage)

follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symlinks (`true` = `-L`, sets `POSIXLY_CORRECT=1`; `false` = `-h`, unsets it)

max_bytes_to_read.description: Maximum bytes to read from a file (`-P bytes=N`)

max_elf_notes.description: Maximum number of ELF notes processed (`-P elf_notes=N`)

max_elf_phnum.description: Maximum number of ELF program headers processed (`-P elf_phnum=N`)

max_elf_shnum.description: Maximum number of ELF section headers processed (`-P elf_shnum=N`)

max_elf_shsize.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of ELF section headers processed (`-P elf_shsize=N`)

max_encoding_bytes.description: Maximum bytes used to determine text encoding (`-P encoding=N`)

max_indirection.description: Recursion limit for indirect magic (`-P indir=N`)

max_name_use_count.description: Use count limit for name/use magic (`-P name=N`)

max_regex_length.description: Maximum length for regex searches (`-P regex=N`)
